title: Return scenarios
notice: Illustration, not a forecast or investment advice. You can lose all invested capital. No payment or investment is made here.
sample: The catalog contains fictitious testnet examples. Their displayed rates are sample terms, not verified live offers. Calculations below use an illustrative EUR amount, not a conversion from USDC.
manual: My own assumptions, not an offer
reinvest: Reinvest at the same assumed rate
withdraw: Receive income monthly, principal remains at risk
assumptionsNote: The default deductions of 0.5, 2.5 and 6 percentage points are illustrative comparison values. They are not measured default probabilities or validated risk estimates for these instruments. The same applies to the 7% ETF, 2.5% deposit and 2% inflation assumptions. Change them to explore other outcomes. A scenario deduction cannot represent every loss, recovery delay or platform failure.
realTerms: Express final wealth in today's purchasing power
referenceWarning: Pre-tax reference comparison only. Taxes, fees, idle cash and explicit default or platform shocks are NOT included here. This separate mode reproduces the reference zero-yield floor; it is not protection against losses. Main results always include the visible tax rate.
negativeWarning: The main model permits losses below the starting principal and total loss. No positive-yield floor applies. Recovery assumptions are not guarantees.
variableWarning: This sample has no verified fixed annual coupon suitable for this model. No fixed return is assigned. Choose manual assumptions to explore a hypothetical return, without treating it as this instrument's terms.
conditionalWarning: This sample coupon applies only until conversion. The calculator does not model conversion, share prices, early repayment or the actual payment schedule.
gross: Gross counterfactual terminal wealth without idle cash, defaults, platform shock, fees or tax
reduction: Difference caused by the scenario deduction
monthly: Average monthly nominal payout over the term
deposit: Illustrative deposit, reinvested, no eligibility check
formula: Reinvestment uses amount × (1 + adjusted annual rate)^(months/12). Monthly payout mode adds amount × adjusted rate × months/12 without compounding; the principal remains invested. Inflation divides terminal wealth by (1 + inflation)^(months/12), including cumulative payouts as a terminal-value simplification. ETF and deposit comparisons always assume reinvestment. Amounts shown are rounded only for display.
taxes: This separate reference comparison is before taxes, fees and foreign-exchange effects. Main results include the visible tax rate. No deposit-guarantee eligibility or coverage is assessed. ETF returns can be negative, deposits have their own conditions, and neither comparison is a recommendation. This is not the regulatory loss-bearing assessment.
invalid: Check every numeric field, including tax. Enter a positive amount, whole months from 1 to 1200, coupon 0 to 100%, percentages 0 to 100%, whole delay months, and inflation above -100%. No rate is inferred from language or country.
taxBasis: Portugal standard capital-income illustration: 28%, tax year 2026, AT source checked 23 November 2026. Assumes an individual using the standard capital-income rate, not aggregation. Residency, regional rules, income category and treaties can change liability. Change the rate for your confirmed circumstances. Losses and fees are not deducted from taxable interest in this simplified model. This is not tax advice.
platformMonth: Platform failure month (0 means no failure)
stress: Stress: half of performing loans default at the start
advancedNote: All default, recovery, fee, platform, idle-cash and inflation inputs are hypothetical, not measured probabilities or forecasts. Coupon is an effective annual assumption converted to a monthly rate, not a contractual cash-flow schedule. Each month: initial stress, platform shock, borrower defaults, recoveries, interest, tax, fees, then reinvestment or payout. No generic scenario deduction is added. The platform shock affects only its selected share of current performing and idle balances, not previously defaulted receivables. Reinvestment restores the chosen idle-cash share. Withdrawn income stays outside the platform; recovered principal stays idle in payout mode.
taxPaid: Tax paid (no assumed loss or fee relief)
pendingRecovery: Assumed recoveries still pending at the end, not available cash
availableAssets: Performing principal plus cash and cumulative payouts, excludes pending recovery
waterfallNote: Waterfall order: gross, idle cash, borrower defaults, platform failure, fees, tax. Differences are order-dependent counterfactuals, not independent loss estimates. They include lost compounding. Final wealth includes assumed pending recoveries at face value, with no discount or guarantee. Annualized terminal wealth is not an IRR.
nominalWealth: Nominal terminal wealth including pending recoveries
advanced: Idle cash, borrower defaults, platform failure and fees
chartNote: Nominal wealth including cumulative payouts and assumed pending recoveries. Dashed line: starting amount. Horizontal axis: months. The monthly ledger below gives the exact values. This is not a forecast.
